title: Casino Management & Compliance Platform
subtitle: RegTech, Patron Relationship Graph, AML Transaction Monitoring & FinCEN Workflow Engine
summary: A configurable casino compliance platform designed to centralize patron management, external identity verification, AML-driven transaction analysis, CTR/SAR workflows, and audit controls.
problem: Regulated casino operators face severe federal compliance penalties if suspicious betting spikes, cash transactions exceeding regulatory thresholds, or multi-patron collusions go undetected. Disconnected patron records across cage, slots, and tables created high reporting latency and compliance risks.
solution: Engineered a high-throughput Node.js & PostgreSQL compliance engine with dynamic rule evaluation, configurable CTR (Currency Transaction Report) and SAR (Suspicious Activity Report) workflows aligned with U.S. regulatory standards, PII masking, expiring Azure Blob SAS tokens, and an interactive Patron Relationship Graph.
architecture: Client (React/Vue Admin) → API Gateway (Node.js/Express) → JWT Auth & Tenant RBAC → Business Rules Engine → Database (PostgreSQL with PII Masking) → Azure Blob Storage (Encrypted SAS) → External TIN/ID Verification APIs → Scheduled Cron Jobs
highlights: Configurable CTR Workflow: Automated threshold evaluation, review approval, filing preparation, and tamper-proof audit trails
Configurable SAR Workflow: AML risk indicator evaluation, suspicious activity pattern detection, case management, and audit history
External Patron Verification: Real-time identity validation and TIN verification without hardcoded vendor dependencies
Patron Relationship Graph: Visual graph linking patrons, shared accounts, table transactions, proxy relationships, and risk indicators
Secure Document Vault: Multi-tenant document storage using 15-minute expiring Azure Blob SAS tokens and database-level PII masking
businessImpact: Centralized compliance operations across multiple gaming properties, reduced CTR/SAR investigation cycle times, and ensured 100% auditability for regulatory reviews.
technicalChallenges: Evaluating complex AML threshold rules across high-velocity transaction streams in real time while maintaining strict sub-100ms API response times and tenant data isolation.
systemDesign: The architecture decouples the rule execution engine from ingestion queues, allowing compliance officers to update threshold parameters dynamically without redeploying backend services.
security: Sensitive fields such as Social Security Numbers and Tax Identification Numbers are masked at the database and API layer. File uploads utilize short-lived SAS tokens generated per authorized session.
businessRules: Rules evaluate transaction frequency, aggregate cash-in/cash-out amounts within 24-hour rolling windows, and patron proximity alerts.

title: Global Wealth & Asset Management Platform
subtitle: Encrypted Multi-Asset Allocation, Family Sharing, Marketplace & Dynamic Auction Engine
category: Wealth Management • Asset Management • Financial Platform
summary: A comprehensive configurable wealth platform for high-net-worth individuals to manage financial, real estate, and luxury assets through centralized dashboards, family asset sharing, and dynamic auction bidding.
problem: High-net-worth clients and family offices struggled with fragmented spreadsheets and disjointed platforms to track multi-jurisdiction physical assets, shared family ownership stakes, private marketplaces, and real-time asset valuations.
solution: Architected a high-performance React and React Native platform with Redux Persist AES256 local state encryption, dynamic metadata forms, family asset relationship graphs, and a real-time auction bidding engine with configurable counter-bid rules.
architecture: Cross-Platform Clients (React Web & React Native Mobile) → Redux Persist (AES256 Encrypted Cache) → REST API Gateway (Java/Node.js) → AWS EC2 Microservices → PostgreSQL & Financial Feeds
highlights: Dynamic Multi-Asset Tracking: Full lifecycle management for equity, private debt, real estate, and luxury physical holdings
Family Asset Sharing: Configurable ownership allocations between primary users, spouses, children, and trust entities
Configurable Marketplace: Curated asset discovery and transactional trading across private equity and collector categories
Dynamic Auction Engine: Live bidding, counter-bids, automated quote competition, and transaction settlement workflows
Financial Intelligence Dashboard: Real-time asset allocation charts, performance analytics, and activity timelines
businessImpact: Streamlined family office asset management into a single encrypted portal, supporting multi-currency holdings and multi-party ownership visibility.
technicalChallenges: Synchronizing real-time auction bidding competition across mobile and web clients with zero-latency state consistency while maintaining client-side state encryption.
systemDesign: Implemented optimistic UI updates paired with persistent encrypted Redux caching and WebSocket channels for instant auction updates and portfolio valuations.
security: Client-side state persisted in local storage is encrypted using AES-256 with key derivation from the authenticated JWT session.
businessRules: Configurable bidding increments, reserve price thresholds, family member approval gates, and multi-signature authorization.

title: Healthcare & Telemedicine Platform
subtitle: Tele-Critical Care, WebRTC Telemetry, AI Clinical Decision Support & Agora Video
summary: An enterprise telemedicine platform connecting remote intensivists, bedside nurses, and patients through ultra-low latency WebRTC video, live ICU telemetry, and AI-assisted medical report analysis.
problem: Rural and regional ICUs faced severe shortages of critical-care specialists during acute patient deteriorations, requiring instant collaborative audio/video and synchronized patient vitals without data collisions.
solution: Engineered a React and React Native clinical ecosystem leveraging Agora WebRTC for multi-party HD video, Firebase Realtime Database for active session locks, and an AI-assisted decision-support pipeline that highlights abnormal trends for physician review.
architecture: React Clinical Web Portal & React Native Mobile App → Agora WebRTC Gateway → Firebase Realtime State Engine → Java/Node.js REST Services → HIPAA-Compliant Data Storage
highlights: Ultra-Low Latency Telemedicine: Sub-150ms provider-to-provider and patient-to-doctor audio, video, and clinical chat
Live ICU Telemetry & ECG Waveforms: Real-time streaming of patient vitals with dynamic threshold alarms and session locks
AI-Assisted Report Analysis: Report summarization, historical lab trend comparisons, and abnormal-value highlighting for doctor review
Patient & Consultation Management: Centralized medical histories, appointment scheduling, diagnostic reports, and consultation logs
Cross-Platform Mobile App: Native Android & iOS apps with background push notifications for critical clinical escalations
businessImpact: Enabled 24/7 remote intensivist coverage across distributed clinical units, accelerating emergency intervention response times.
technicalChallenges: Rendering 60fps ECG canvas waveforms simultaneously with multi-party Agora video streams on constrained hospital tablet hardware.
systemDesign: Decoupled WebRTC media streams from clinical telemetry sockets to prevent network congestion from degrading video call clarity.
security: End-to-end encrypted WebRTC channels, strict role-based doctor/nurse access control, and HIPAA-aligned data transmission protocols.
businessRules: Decision-support AI operates strictly as an assistive layer highlighting patterns for physician validation; doctors maintain sole clinical authority.

title: POS & Retail Multi-Tenant ERP Platform
subtitle: GST/Non-GST Billing, Warehouse-to-Store Inventory Auto-Reduction & Thermal Engine
summary: An enterprise Point-of-Sale and multi-tenant ERP platform supporting dynamic product catalogs, GST/Non-GST calculation workflows, warehouse-to-store stock reduction, and configurable invoice rendering.
problem: Multi-location retail chains suffered from stock discrepancies between central godowns and retail outlets, slow manual invoice generation, complex mixed-tax compliance, and lack of tenant isolation.
solution: Built a scalable full-stack POS and inventory platform with automatic godown stock reduction on checkout, multi-tier tenant access control, and an interactive invoice generator supporting A4 PDF, thermal receipts, and custom templates.
architecture: React & React Native POS Frontend → Node.js / Express API → Tenant Isolation Middleware → PostgreSQL / MongoDB Multi-Tenant Storage → Thermal & PDF Print Engine
highlights: Configurable GST / Non-GST Billing: Dynamic tax breakdown, itemized discounts, customer-tier pricing, and automated invoice totals
Automated Godown / Warehouse Sync: Real-time stock reduction across linked central warehouses immediately upon point-of-sale completion
Complete Sales & Purchase Workflows: Integrated supplier purchase orders, vendor invoices, sales returns, and automated inventory adjustments
Multi-Tenant Organization Model: Hierarchical tenant isolation supporting multiple organizations, branches, and custom role permissions
Interactive Multi-Format Invoicing: Seamless switching between A4 PDF documentation, 80mm thermal receipts, and branded merchant templates
businessImpact: Eliminated manual inventory reconciliation across retail locations and expedited checkout processing time per transaction.
technicalChallenges: Ensuring ACID-compliant inventory stock decrements under concurrent multi-register peak sales events without race conditions.
systemDesign: Utilized PostgreSQL row-level locks and transactional batch queries for inventory deduction, paired with an offline-capable client checkout queue.
security: Tenant-aware middleware guarantees absolute data separation across client organizations, backed by role-based operational permissions.
businessRules: Configurable tax rules by product category, automatic volume discount triggers, and return authorization validation.

title: Inventory Management & Multi-Channel Audit Platform
subtitle: Shopify, Greenbits, QuickBooks ETL Sync, Bulk Ingestion & Automated Audit Reports
summary: A high-volume inventory synchronization and audit platform connecting e-commerce storefronts, point-of-sale endpoints, and accounting systems with scheduled ETL jobs and subscription billing.
problem: Disparate data formats across Shopify, Greenbits POS, and QuickBooks resulted in inventory overselling, out-of-sync financial ledgers, and days of manual audit spreadsheets.
solution: Engineered a robust integration platform utilizing Node.js, Node-RED, and PostgreSQL to execute bi-directional inventory syncing, bulk CSV/Excel ingestion, scheduled audit reports, and Stripe subscription management.
architecture: Shopify / Greenbits / QuickBooks Webhooks ↕ Node-RED ETL Pipeline ↕ Node.js Sync Engine ↕ PostgreSQL Multi-Tenant Database ↕ React Analytics Portal
highlights: Bi-Directional Multi-Channel Sync: Real-time stock parity between Shopify online stores, Greenbits POS, and QuickBooks ledgers
High-Volume Bulk Ingestion: Optimized parser for multi-thousand row CSV, Excel, and Google Sheet catalog uploads with schema validation
Automated Audit & Compliance Reporting: Scheduled nightly disparity reports, stock variance audits, and ledger reconciliations
Subscription Billing Management: Tiered enterprise subscription access and automated billing workflows via Stripe integration
Resilient Webhook Handlers: Dead-letter queue and automatic retry mechanisms for third-party API rate limits and network dropouts
businessImpact: Achieved 99.9% inventory sync accuracy across channels and eliminated manual inventory ledger audits.
technicalChallenges: Handling asymmetric API rate limits across external vendor endpoints during massive multi-product catalog updates.
systemDesign: Implemented Node-RED throttled queue workers with Redis state caching to buffer burst webhook traffic cleanly.
security: Encrypted third-party API tokens stored with AES-256 and OAuth2 refresh token rotation.
businessRules: Configurable safety stock buffers, automated out-of-stock delisting triggers, and price sync rules.

title: Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) Tracker
subtitle: Offline-First Mobile Synchronization, Multi-Target Timers & SQLite Delta Engine
summary: An offline-first clinical tracking application for behavioral therapists to record simultaneous interval and duration timers with automatic zero-loss cloud synchronization.
problem: Therapists operating in clinical rooms with spotty or zero Wi-Fi connectivity lost critical session data if web apps crashed or dropped connection during live patient assessments.
solution: Built cross-platform web and mobile applications using React, React Native, and SQLite/PouchDB with an offline-first event-sourcing delta queue that syncs automatically when network connectivity returns.
architecture: React Native Mobile (iOS/Android) & Web → Local SQLite / PouchDB Storage → Network State Listener → Redux Delta Queue → Node.js REST API → PostgreSQL Cloud DB
highlights: Offline-First Data Architecture: Full continuous data collection without internet; automatic two-way sync on network restoration
Simultaneous 1-to-N Duration Timers: Sub-millisecond accurate tracking for multiple concurrent behavioral targets and interventions
Conflict-Free Delta Queue: Idempotent event journal preventing duplicate entries or state corruption during interrupted syncs
Session Management & Clinical Graphs: Longitudinal behavioral progress charts, trial-by-trial logs, and therapist notes
Secure Encrypted Local Storage: Local SQLite database encryption protecting sensitive patient health records on mobile devices
businessImpact: Enabled uninterrupted clinical therapy sessions across thousands of patient hours with zero recorded data loss.
technicalChallenges: Maintaining microsecond precision across multiple active timers during background app switching and OS battery optimizations.
systemDesign: Used native bridge timestamp deltas combined with SQLite transactional journaling to ensure timer fidelity across app lifecycles.
security: Local database encryption, biometric authentication, and HIPAA-compliant data transport over TLS 1.3.
businessRules: Session timeout protocols, target mastery threshold calculations, and mandatory supervisory sign-off workflows.

title: Tele-Critical Care Collaborative Network
subtitle: Doctor-to-Doctor Tele-ICU Consulting, Live Vitals & Agora Low-Latency WebRTC
summary: A specialized real-time consultation network enabling bedside critical-care teams to initiate immediate encrypted audio/video and telemetry sharing with remote consulting intensivists.
problem: Emergency ICU escalations required instant multi-specialist consensus, but existing video conferencing lacked synchronized medical telemetry and clinical session ownership locks.
solution: Engineered a collaborative tele-ICU system integrating Agora WebRTC with Firebase Realtime Database for mutual session locks, ensuring only one active lead physician controls diagnostic views at a time.
architecture: Doctor A (Remote) ↕ Secure WebRTC Layer (Agora) ↕ Doctor B (Bedside) ↕ Firebase Realtime State Lock ↕ Patient ICU Telemetry Feeds
highlights: Provider-to-Provider HD Consultation: Instant sub-second video and audio connectivity between remote intensivists and bedside teams
Synchronized Clinical State Lock: Firebase-backed mutual exclusion preventing conflicting telemetry adjustments during critical reviews
Real-Time Patient Monitor Streaming: Real-time telemetry feed displaying SpO2, heart rate, invasive BP, and ventilator metrics
Interactive Diagnostic Annotation: Collaborative whiteboard and visual highlighting on radiology scans during live calls
Audit-Logged Clinical Events: Automatic timestamping of clinical observations, consulting physician orders, and call durations
businessImpact: Reduced emergency specialist consultation wait times from hours to under 60 seconds during acute ICU emergencies.
technicalChallenges: Managing WebRTC peer connections across restrictive hospital firewalls and variable bandwidth clinical networks.
systemDesign: Utilized Agora SD-RTN (Software Defined Real-time Network) with dynamic bitrate fallback to preserve audio clarity under poor signal conditions.
security: End-to-end encrypted media streams, ephemeral session tokens, and strict verified physician credentialing.
businessRules: Mandatory primary physician handoff protocols and automated emergency notification broadcast triggers.

title: Enterprise Operations & Job Management Dashboard
subtitle: Vue.js, Azure Microservices, Task Queue Throughput & Microsoft OAuth
summary: An administrative operations portal for orchestrating batch compute jobs, monitoring multi-tenant worker queues, managing Azure cloud resources, and visualizing system throughput.
problem: Operations engineers were using disparate command-line tools and raw log files to trigger batch processing jobs, leading to unmonitored job failures and lack of role-based execution governance.
solution: Built a high-productivity administrative portal using Vue.js, Vuetify, Python REST APIs, and Azure integration with interactive ApexCharts telemetry, Microsoft OAuth SSO, and dynamic form validation.
architecture: Vue.js / Vuetify Admin UI → Microsoft OAuth SSO → Python/Azure API Gateway → Azure Service Bus Queue → Worker Nodes → PostgreSQL / CosmosDB
highlights: Interactive Task Queue Throughput Matrix: Real-time visual monitoring of Queued, Running, Succeeded, and Failed background worker jobs
Dynamic Job Configuration Forms: Schema-driven input parameters with custom validation rules tailored to specific compute job types
Enterprise Microsoft OAuth SSO: Seamless integration with corporate Active Directory, tenant policies, and granular user roles
Real-Time Telemetry & ApexCharts: Dynamic resource utilization charts, error rate distributions, and execution latency trends
Comprehensive Audit & Log Inspection: Searchable execution logs with error stack trace formatting and one-click job retry workflows
businessImpact: Streamlined batch operations management, decreased job debugging time, and provided clear visibility into cloud resource consumption.
technicalChallenges: Streaming continuous telemetry updates for hundreds of concurrent job executions without degrading browser UI responsiveness.
systemDesign: Implemented virtualized data tables and buffered WebSocket metrics updates to maintain 60fps chart rendering.
security: Azure AD token validation, tenant-isolated job queues, and strict administrative execution permissions.
businessRules: Configurable retry policies, rate limits per tenant, and automated escalation alerts for prolonged queue blockages.
